args.summary:
Modeled the 3-span (30+40+30 m) cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge as a 2D spine beam with pier columns (system: continuous_on_piers).

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); single-cell cast box section integrated to A = 6.532 m², I = 3.564 m⁴ (MR-02).
- Materials: C50 girder Ec = 34500 MPa, γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1); C40 pier Ec = 32500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5). Self weight w = 169.83 kN/m, mass m = 17.31 t/m (girder self-weight only).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer value per MR-00): Abutments 0 & 3 = PTFE sliding, 2/line, S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0; Pier 1 = PTFE sliding, 2/line, S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0; Pier 2 = plain fixed, 2/line, S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13090.9 kN/m.
- Piers: twin 1.6 m circular columns combined, Pier 1 L=14 m, Pier 2 L=8 m, A=4.021 m², I=0.6434 m⁴ each.
- Traffic: Class I, one-way, 3 lanes; qk=10.5 kN/m, ξ=0.78, Pk = 320/340/320 kN.

Results (f1 = 3.434 Hz):
- Impact factor μ = 0.2023 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).
- Self-weight reactions [1839.7, 6646.0, 6665.6, 1831.9] kN.
- Self-weight midspan moments [8489.6, 12615.6, 8371.8] kN·m; support moments [-21233.0, -21468.6] kN·m.
- Max live-load positive moment 9701.3 kN·m (mid-span 2); max negative moment -7558.3 kN·m.

All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
